summary: Reproduced and fix confirmed with no stubs. After forwarding two real rows, eval/compare_q_logits.py raised ValueError (Key tensor is invalid, expected torch.Tensor but received tuple) in save_tensor at eval/compare_q.py:82 at 8ff65b874202 and at line 88 at the fix parent bcaa636f6697, and wrote no file. At the fix f02c9afd6afa it wrote tensor.0 and tensor.1, the first with shape [1, 256, 151936]. This supersedes the stubbed attempts 001 to 003.
what_ran: repro.py runs the unmodified eval/compare_q_logits.py command with -r 2 -rpb 1 on GPU 1, using wikitext-2-raw-v1 test split (Hub dataset wikitext at b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3) and unquantized Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, then reads the output file's keys.
limits: Two rows, one model. Tensor values were not compared with a reference, and the file was not consumed by a later compare_q run. Third-party packages are real, resolved as of 2025-06-01 (transformers 4.52.4, datasets 3.6.0, gptqmodel 2.2.0, aqlm 1.1.7, autoawq 0.2.9, vptq 0.0.5.post1, bitsandbytes 0.46.0, exllamav2 0.3.1, llama-cpp-python 0.3.9); logbar, tokenicer and device_smi were added because gptqmodel imports them.
